credential_boundary.resolution: TypeScript resolves the active Workspace repo binding and its referenced Secret only after an authenticated human execution request.
credential_boundary.domain_auth: The internal Domain API remains independently authenticated by its bearer token before reading the ephemeral headers.
credential_boundary.durability: The credential is absent from command JSON, receipts, audits, outbox events, Temporal payloads and connector facts.
credential_boundary.sentinel_proof: github-connector-credential.test.ts resolves a random encrypted sentinel, observes one value-free Secret access audit, and scans tool connection, repo binding, secret metadata, versions and access events to prove the sentinel is absent.

effect_reconciliation.lookup_rule: found finalizes one receipt, absent may create only with the current claim, and inconclusive never creates
faults_proven: concurrent execution while a live claim exists
retry convergence from lookup-found without a second create
database_guards: unique provider_marker on ActionRequest and EffectReceipt
no provider call inside a database transaction

execution_revalidation: approved parameters hash and requester/approver separation
valid Acceptance for the same Workspace, Target, Submission and Revision
active Workspace GitHub repo binding and exact facade connection ID

verification.result: 243 migrations applied to a fresh PostgreSQL database
General server 4,713 passed; one untouched UI timing assertion failed; isolated file rerun 18/18 passed

real_github_prerequisites_for_T010: A user-authorized writable GitHub test repository
An active Workspace tool connection whose referenced access token can list and create pull requests
A pushed head branch and an expected base branch in the bound repository
A fresh Target journey whose immutable Submission commit binding corresponds to the tested code
Permission to leave exactly one marker-bearing acceptance PR in that repository
residual_risks: A real GitHub credential and repository were not supplied during T006; T010 must prove the contract against a real provider and inspect the resulting PR and EffectReceipt.
The marker lives in the PR body, so a human edit that removes it before crash reconciliation can leave an outcome inconclusive rather than falsely creating another PR.
The repo-wide Vitest run exposed one pre-existing UI timing flake; the isolated rerun passed and the file is outside T006 scope.
